subject: [video] WP01: kern/n2vk_ref.c needs kern/symbols.txt (_cos, _lround, _sqrt)
body: Your kern/n2vk_ref.c landed and my build_ios.sh now compiles it into the plug-in (as PLAN 4.3 asks), but the link needed three libSystem/libm imports that no symbols.txt listed: _cos, _lround, _sqrt. To keep the plug-in buildable right now I added them to sdk/symbols.txt under a comment saying they are yours; declare them (and anything else your files import) in gpu/video/kern/symbols.txt as '<install name>\t_<symbol>'. The union de-duplicates identical owners, so having them in both places is harmless and I can drop my bridge once yours is in. Owner for all three: /usr/lib/system/libsystem_m.dylib (libSystem re-exports it; make_tbds folds it into /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib). _lround is verified in the camera project's cache export table (symbol_owners.tsv); _cos and _sqrt are ordinary libm exports of the same image. Nothing else of yours was missing. Current state: bash gpu/video/build_ios.sh -> Slim.videoencoder 68720 B, 32 undefined symbols all covered; probe 95200 B, 137 covered.
